result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but the horizontally scrolling card rows ('Fastest near you' and the category chips) are clipped at the right edge without clear visual affordance, and the third restaurant card's title is truncated. These are minor-to-major usability/cosmetic issues rather than functional breakage.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' row, the third card ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right screen edge and its title is truncated mid-word with no ellipsis, making it look broken rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a clear scroll affordance (e.g., a fade-out gradient or peeking card with consistent padding) and apply proper text truncation with an ellipsis so the cut-off looks intentional.

issues.description: The category filter chip row ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi', 'Burgers', 'Healthy') is also clipped at the right edge with a partially visible chip, giving an unfinished appearance.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll rows show a partial next item with consistent right padding or a fade indicator to signal scrollability.

issues.description: The notification bell icon relies on a small red dot with no text or badge count, which may be missed by users and is not clearly announced to screen readers.
issues.suggestion: Provide an accessible label (e.g., 'Notifications, 1 unread') and consider a more visible badge with a count.

issues.description: Delivery fee and time metadata use inconsistent formatting across cards (e.g., '€0.90 delivery' under the title vs. '€0 delivery' as a badge on the image), which can cause mild confusion.
issues.suggestion: Standardize how delivery fee and ETA are presented across all restaurant cards for consistency.
